order: Even rounds start with RC6 in cohort 1 and candidate in cohort 2. Odd rounds reverse. Each cohort starts a new process and empty browser profile. Warmups and errors are retained. No trimming or reruns for a favorable timing.
statistics: Median averages both center values. p95 nearest-rank. Report spread and each cohort separately. GC, file validation and oracle run outside timed intervals. Browser polling ~12ms, clocks high-resolution monotonic. Shared Linux host; sample load separately, no outlier exclusion.

officialBrowserLifecycle.scope: Official candidate Chromium uses the separately hash-pinned fixed four-pair lifecycle. Each scheduled measured arm is attempted once, failures and incomplete pairs are retained, and the next flow still runs. Node uses one warmup pair per case.

capacity.peakDefinition: Maximum observed Runtime.getHeapUsage.usedSize bytes on the same page target as post-GC. Native/process/worker memory excluded. Unknown remains null. Five runs support completion checks only; estimate latency tail per size on a separate 40+40 sample per-size study before advertising a percentile SLA.
capacity.capacityClaim: Measure the historical 6,30,118-section fixtures. Their page counts depend on actual pagination. No 500/1,000-page claim.
